t: Robust 5-tier metal garage shelving unit provides an ideal storage solution for workshops and garages. This durable unit is perfect for organising tools, equipment, and supplies in busy trade environments or home workshops. It features a galvanised steel frame and five strong MDF shelves, each capable of holding up to 250kg, with a total bay capacity of 1250kg. The rivet system allows for quick and straightforward installation, and the shelves are adjustable to maximise storage versatility. A corrosion-resistant finish ensures long-lasting performance, providing reliable storage. Can be assembled as a workbench.
